clue.text: Simmer with emotion and give a little cry, offered leftovers?

parts.note: to bubble is to seethe or simmer with feeling
taken as written
to squeak is to give a small high cry

explanation.surface: Someone seething and yelping when served yesterday's scraps.
explanation.walkthrough: BUBBLE AND SQUEAK is a British dish of fried-up leftover potato and cabbage; 'offered' just joins the wordplay to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The dish is traditionally made from the remains of a previous meal, especially a Sunday roast.

clue.text: Responsible for tantrums out of public view?

definitions.meaning: a person ..., read literally, is the one causing the scenes or tantrums
backstage, away from the audience's sight

explanation.definitionFit: Backstage work happens out of sight; read playfully, being behind scenes means causing the fuss.

clue.text: Scottish playwright runs into block

parts.note: J. M. Barrie, the Scottish author of Peter Pan
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: A dramatist from Scotland charges into an obstacle.
explanation.definitionFit: A barrier is an obstruction, something that blocks the way.

clue.text: Student returns low mill machine

parts.note: L is the learner plate, a student driver

indicators.note: returns tells us the word for a cow's low is read backwards

parts.note: to low is to moo, as cattle do

explanation.surface: A student comes back to an old mill with its humming machinery.
explanation.definitionFit: A loom is the weaving machine found in a textile mill.

clue.text: Bearing left for Luton, say

parts.note: an air is a bearing or manner
port is the left side of a ship

explanation.surface: Directions telling a traveller to keep left on the way to Luton.
explanation.walkthrough: Luton is a town north of London with an international airport; 'say' marks it as an example.
explanation.definitionFit: Luton is one example of a place where passenger flights take off and land.

clue.text: Refuse to enter this collectors' item

definitions.text: Refuse to enter this collectors' item

parts.words: Refuse to enter this collectors' item
parts.note: read refuse as the noun, rubbish, which goes into the thing that bin men, refuse collectors, empty

explanation.definitionFit: A wheelie bin is the container refuse collectors empty, so it is literally their item.

clue.text: Landing place sounds important

indicators.note: sounds says we want a word pronounced like the word for important

parts.note: a key issue is an important one

explanation.surface: A harbour jetty is said to matter a great deal.
explanation.definitionFit: A wharf where boats tie up and unload is a stone landing stage.

clue.text: Leave out note for lift

indicators.note: out suggests the letters of leave are put out of order

parts.note: te is the seventh note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: Instructions to skip a musical note to raise the pitch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Leave out' reads as an instruction to omit something, but 'out' alone is the anagram signal, turning the word into ELEVA; TE is the sol-fa note.
explanation.definitionFit: To lift something is to raise it up, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Guarding merry-making, as watch should be?

parts.note: keeping is holding safe or guarding
a good time is fun and revelry

explanation.surface: Sentries watching over a party, timed like clockwork.
explanation.definitionFit: A reliable wristwatch runs accurately, never gaining or losing minutes.

clue.text: Entertain with port

definitions.meaning: to entertain a thought or feeling is to hold it in mind

explanation.definitionFit: One harbours a grudge as one entertains it; a harbour is also where ships shelter.

clue.text: Twin cats?

definitions.meaning: conjoined twins are called by this name
a breed of slender blue-eyed cats from Thailand

explanation.definitionFit: The adjective names both joined twins and an oriental breed of cats.

clue.text: Man placed in line-out

indicators.note: out, attached to line, tells us its four letters are thrown out of order

explanation.surface: A player is positioned in the line-out at rugby.
explanation.walkthrough: A line-out is a rugby restart; here 'out' just scrambles LINE.
explanation.definitionFit: Crosswords use 'man' to clue any male first name, here a common one.

clue.text: Act, but wrong to be unsure

parts.note: to do is to act

indicators.note: wrong suggests the letters of but are set out incorrectly

explanation.surface: An actor feeling uncertain because a line came out wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Act, but' tempts as a six-letter anagram, one letter too many; only the second word is jumbled by 'wrong', giving UBT.
explanation.definitionFit: To feel uncertain or have misgivings about something is to question it.

clue.text: Some dress-a rich Indian wears it

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A rich woman's dress is something worn in India.
explanation.definitionFit: This draped length of cloth is the traditional garment of women in India.

clue.text: Promote sale initially in appropriate part of car

indicators.note: in puts the letter inside the word for the car's storage space

parts.note: the boot is the storage space of a car, apt for a car-boot sale

indicators.note: initially tells us only the opening letter of sale is used

explanation.surface: An advert pushing a car-boot sale.
explanation.walkthrough: A boot is the British name for a car's trunk.
explanation.definitionFit: To promote something is to give it a lift or push it forward.

clue.text: Charm initially unwanted for race meeting

indicators.note: initially unwanted says the opening letter of the word for charm is dropped

parts.note: a mascot is a lucky charm

explanation.surface: A lucky charm that nobody wanted at first, carried to the races.
explanation.walkthrough: ASCOT is a famous English racecourse in Berkshire, home of Royal Ascot.
explanation.definitionFit: Royal Ascot is the celebrated June horse-racing fixture in England.

clue.text: Muster for duty to clear lumber

definitions.meaning: to report or assemble, as troops do for parade
to empty a cupboard or room of junk

explanation.definitionFit: Troops turn out on parade; you turn out an attic by emptying its junk.

clue.text: Useful fund could be within one's clutch

definitions.text: Useful fund could be within one's clutch

parts.words: Useful fund could be within one's clutch
parts.note: a clutch is a set of eggs in a nest as well as one's grasp, so savings held close become a bird's egg

explanation.definitionFit: Savings put aside for the future are named after an egg left in a nest.

clue.text: Time passes so, as sleep is problematic

indicators.note: is problematic hints the letters of as sleep are in a troubled, jumbled state

explanation.surface: Sleeplessness makes the night drag on.
explanation.definitionFit: Time is said to go by in this way, as minutes slip past.

clue.text: Fool, for example, over excellent weapon

indicators.note: in a down clue over places the earlier pieces above the next

parts.note: an ass is a fool
A1 read as AI means first-rate

explanation.surface: An idiot showing off a superb weapon.
explanation.walkthrough: An ASSEGAI is a slender iron-tipped spear used in southern Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: This southern African spear is a hunting and fighting weapon.

clue.text: Drunkard one's interrupted very quickly

indicators.note: interrupted means the word for drunkard is broken into by the other piece

parts.note: a sot is a habitual drunk
taken as written, without the apostrophe

explanation.surface: A tipsy man is cut off mid-sentence in a hurry.
explanation.definitionFit: Earliest or at the first chance means as fast as possible.

clue.text: Almost demonstrate one's old condition

indicators.note: almost means the final letter of the word for demonstrate is cut off

parts.note: to prove is to demonstrate
one is I, so one's is I'S, read as IS

explanation.surface: Nearly showing what someone's old state of affairs was.
explanation.definitionFit: A clause attached to an agreement is a stipulation or condition.

clue.text: eg Sower quietly going over ploughed land

parts.note: p, piano, is the musical sign for quietly
arable land is land that is ploughed for crops

explanation.surface: A farmer sowing seed softly crossing a tilled field.
explanation.walkthrough: The Sower is the story Jesus tells in the Gospels about seed falling on different ground.
explanation.definitionFit: The Sower is one of the moral stories told by Jesus in the Gospels.

clue.text: Some idea that sepia has connection with fish

parts.note: sepia is the brown ink of the cuttlefish
ling is a long cod-like sea fish

explanation.surface: A notion linking cuttlefish ink to a fish.
explanation.definitionFit: A vague notion or hint is a faint sense of something.

clue.text: Squint at performers

definitions.meaning: a ... in the eye is a squint

explanation.definitionFit: An eye with a turn is said to have a squint; the actors make up the company.

clue.text: Rudely brief, securing love to woo

indicators.note: securing means the word for rudely brief holds the other piece inside it

parts.note: curt means rudely short
love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: A brusque suitor trying to win affection.
explanation.definitionFit: To pay suit to someone in hope of marriage is to woo them.

clue.text: Second child has a slide

parts.note: a kid is a child

explanation.surface: Another youngster gets a turn in the playground.
explanation.definitionFit: A vehicle sliding out of control on a slippery road performs one.

clue.text: King converted oil to metric quantity

parts.note: K is the chess abbreviation for king

indicators.note: converted means the letters of oil are changed into a new order

explanation.surface: A monarch changes oil into metric units.
explanation.definitionFit: Short for kilogram, it is a unit of mass in the metric system.

clue.text: He may have some ethereal top notes

definitions.text: He may have some ethereal top notes

indicators.note: some indicates a part of the following words gives the answer

explanation.surface: A singer who reaches for heavenly high notes.
explanation.walkthrough: The run of letters sits across 'ethereal top'; a male alto sings high notes, so the whole clue also defines.
explanation.definitionFit: A male countertenor voice sings in a register high above ordinary men's.

clue.text: Casual dress 11 messed up with egg

indicators.note: messed up signals the pool of letters is jumbled

parts.note: refers to the answer to 11 across, a man's name

explanation.surface: Someone's casual outfit is spoiled by spilt egg.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman's flimsy dressing gown or loose informal attire.

clue.text: Chime popular with one opera composer

parts.note: a bell chimes
in means popular or fashionable
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A bell ringing with a favourite composer of opera.
explanation.walkthrough: Vincenzo Bellini wrote Norma and La Sonnambula.
explanation.definitionFit: Vincenzo Bellini was a nineteenth-century Italian composer of bel canto operas.

clue.text: Hopeful gets into trouble with spoken blunder

indicators.note: trouble read as a verb means stir up, so the preceding letters are disturbed

explanation.surface: An optimist lands in difficulty through a careless remark.
explanation.walkthrough: 'trouble' rearranges HOPEFUL GETS INTO, all fifteen letters.
explanation.definitionFit: An accidental error in speech, saying a word you did not mean.
